what: PORYGON2 v2 — the value net over the PUBLIC state with per-field UNK tokens and both players' ratings as inputs; pretrained on closed-sheet bo1, fine-tuned on open-sheet bo3. Written 2026-09-29/30 BEFORE any v2 fit and before any v2 game. The design and its citations: solver/porygon2/v2/DESIGN.md.
status: PRE-REGISTERED, NOT RUN. No training, no gate, no SPRT has been run.

data.bo1: solver/out/porygon2-v2/bo1/games.jsonl.gz, manifest solver/porygon2/v2/manifest-bo1.json (inputs and output by sha256). A rebuilt dataset is a different dataset: the fit stamps the sha256 it read.
data.split: player split sha256('abra-prior-v0:' + toID(name)) mod 100 (<80 train, <90 val, else test), lifted to the game: test if either player is test, else val if either is val, else train
data.positions_per_game: K = 1 fresh uniform draw per game per epoch (AlphaGo / Expert Iteration). Ablations K = 2 and K = all, chosen only if bo3 validation log-loss prefers them.

inputs.state: the public state at the |turn|n line (reveal.js x): 12 member tokens, 2 side tokens, 1 field token; UNK embeddings per field kind, distinct from NONE
inputs.facts: MEDICHAM pair facts through a frozen release (eaa5becc54eb or later, stamped): v1's TFACT aggregates over KNOWN moves only; unknown item -> no item, unknown ability -> 'No Ability', with unk_moves / unk_item / unk_ability per token. NOT solver/arena/teams.js buildBody (it fills an unknown ability with the species' first ability).
inputs.ratings: mine and the opponent's pre-game rating: 100-point bin embeddings (UNRATED for null) + (r - 1300)/200, injected into every block's attention queries (Maia-2 form)
inputs.query: in play: my rating input = 1600, the opponent's = their displayed ladder rating

architecture: pre-LN transformer, 17 tokens (12 member + 2 side + 1 field + 2 rating), 2 blocks, d 48, 4 heads, FFN 96; antisymmetric value by chair swap; no positional encoding across member tokens

targets.main_bo3_deep: y = 0.5 z + 0.5 v_deep where a deep label exists (v1's selfplay_deep rule, solver/porygon2/v1/label.js on the stamped release); bo1: never
targets.aux: member survival + end HP (per member token, masked if never seen, masked in forfeits); material (final alive difference, 9-way; final HP-fraction difference, regression; masked in forfeits); next KO side (me / opp / both / none) and delay (0, 1, 2, 3+); turns remaining (0, 1, 2, 3-4, 5+)
targets.loss_weights: main 1.0; auxiliary heads together scaled to 10-40% of the main head's gradient norm, measured on the first 200 steps and then frozen

schedule.A_pretrain: bo1 TRAIN; all heads; unequal-rating games (|r1 - r2| >= 100) sampled 2x; AdamW lr 1e-3 wd 1e-4 dropout 0.1 batch 512 seed 1; select the epoch with the lowest bo1 VAL log-loss vs z; at most 30 epochs
schedule.B_finetune: initialise from A; bo3 TRAIN with 25% of each batch replayed from bo1 TRAIN; lr 3e-4; select the epoch with the lowest bo3 VAL log-loss vs z; at most 30 epochs
schedule.C_search_targets: OWED and optional: bo3 positions with deep labels; self-play only from the strong search; decided after the v1 deep-label refit reports (docs/_reports/2026-09-30-porygon2-deep-labels.md)

gates.a_heldout: PASS iff the 95% upper bound (bootstrap over games, 2,000 resamples, seed 1) of log-loss(v2) - log-loss(v1) against the OUTCOME is < 0 on the pooled bo3 TEST games with v1_unseen = true, AND the point estimate is <= 0 in every min-rating band (<1100, 1100-1199, 1200-1299, >=1300) holding at least 200 such games. v1 = the PORYGON2 net inside the champion league file at launch, named by sha256 in the run. Reported beside it: the count-HP logistic; Brier and 10-bin ECE; turns 1-3 separately; the bo1 TEST split by band incl. >=1500 (diagnostic); each auxiliary head's loss; ablations no-pretrain, no-aux, no-rating, K = 2, K = all.
gates.cost: before (c): v2's median leaf cost (solver/porygon2/v1/bench.js method, same 300 positions) at most 1.5x v1's
gates.c_sprt: only if (a) passes and the cost bar holds: solver/machamp/sprt.js, MILTANK with v2 as the leaf vs MILTANK with v1, both with gen5 MAG + DODUO, k 4x4, 1 reserved switch row, depth 0, 1,000 ms per decision (equal wall-clock), --info honest, TEST team pairs of data/team-pool-frozen-regmc, release eaa5becc54eb or later (stamped), elo0 0, elo1 +20, alpha = beta = 0.05, at most 2,000 games, battle seed 9301. PASS iff H1. Read once, at the bound or the budget; no interim LLR.
gates.land: v2 replaces v1 in a league file only if (a) and (c) pass and the parity test (Node vs Python, worst |diff| <= 1e-9, RED on a perturbation first) is green

counters: every fit and the SPRT print: positions read per stage, UNK share of member fields, leaf evaluations served, fallbacks; a zero or a fallback is called out

addendum_2026_09_30.when: 2026-09-30, written BEFORE any v2 training run beyond a 2-epoch smoke test on 1,500 train games, and before any TEST row was read. Nothing above is changed; this fixes what the text above left open.
addendum_2026_09_30.data: Rebuilt 2026-09-30 on the same parsed stores (bo1 sha256 341e5953c4c7..., bo3 3e5affee9991...) with engine/quality.js of abra/regmc 1.36.0 (tempo clause): bo1 27,603 games / 222,744 positions, bo3 25,295 / 200,620. Encoded by solver/porygon2/v2/encode.js on release eaa5becc54eb (solver/out/porygon2-v2/<fmt>/tensors/, 4 shards each).
addendum_2026_09_30.history_fields: A reveal position carries no action history, so the shield streak, turns in, PP and the choice lock are NOT inputs (solver/porygon2/v2/features.js). The play-time producer blanks the same fields.
addendum_2026_09_30.k_choice: K in {1, 2, all} is chosen by the stage-B model's bo3 VALIDATION log-loss (the text above: "chosen only if validation log-loss prefers them"); K = 1 wins ties within 0.0005. The ablations (no-pretrain, no-aux, no-rating) are run at the chosen K and are reported, never selected.
addendum_2026_09_30.lr_schedule: AdamW at the stated lr with a cosine decay over the 30-epoch maximum; epoch selection as stated.
addendum_2026_09_30.gate_a_v1: v1 = solver/porygon2/model/porygon2-v1.json, sha256 01bb559ef0e7e8e22f098466ac8ad5a1782c7cc029cb83838797fa0dd1b4d3f5 (the v1 whose training data defines v1_unseen). The champion league file (solver/machamp/league/gen5.json) still carries gen5's own net, because v1 never replaced it; gen5's net is scored on the same positions and REPORTED, not gated.
addendum_2026_09_30.gate_a_positions: Every turn-start position of every bo3 TEST game with v1_unseen = true for which both v2 (encode.js) and v1 (solver/human/build_dataset.js -> solver/porygon2/v2/score_v1.js, the same fromDataset -> encode path as v1/build.js) produced a value, paired on (game id, turn). Coverage is reported. Each position weighs 1; the bootstrap resamples games (2,000, seed 1). A game with no winner is dropped (v1's builder skips it).
addendum_2026_09_30.gate_a_v2_inputs: v2 is read with both players' actual pre-game ratings (null -> UNRATED). Reported beside it, not gating: v2 with both ratings UNRATED.
addendum_2026_09_30.gate_a_bands: Bands by the lower of the two ratings: <1100, 1100-1199, 1200-1299, >=1300 (merged). Unrated games are in the pooled set and are reported as their own row; they are not one of the four gating bands. A band gates only if it holds >= 200 eligible games.
addendum_2026_09_30.gate_a_reported: Brier, 10-bin ECE and a reliability table for v2, v1 and gen5; turns 1-3 separately; the count-HP logistic (fitted on bo3 TRAIN positions against z); each auxiliary head's loss on the eligible positions; the bo1 TEST split by band incl. >=1500 and >=1600 for v2 alone (v1 cannot read a closed sheet); every ablation's pooled delta.
addendum_2026_09_30.read_once: solver/porygon2/v2/gate_a.py reads the test split once, for the selected model, and writes solver/porygon2/v2/gate-a.json. It is not re-run to try another model.

addendum_2026_09_30b.when: 2026-09-30, after the first training attempt was killed by a pause (no model saved, gate not read) and BEFORE any training on the data below.
addendum_2026_09_30b.quality_rule: Will, 2026-09-30: for the VALUE-NET datasets the game-shape codes of engine/quality.js (forfeit_no_action, short, partial_bring) do NOT exclude a game: forfeits and short games are real outcomes. Each kept row records its quality reasons in `quality_reasons`. Bots, illegal teams, custom-rule games, own accounts, Illusion rooms and the pre-Eject-Button-fix games stay excluded.

The data line of addendum_2026_09_30 is superseded by this one; every other clause of that addendum stands.
addendum_2026_09_30b.gate_a_eligible: bo3 TEST games with v1_unseen = true: 1,526 (10,733 positions). By min-rating band: <1100 577, 1100-1199 413, 1200-1299 160, >=1300 82, unrated 294. So the gating bands are <1100 and 1100-1199.
addendum_2026_09_30b.checkpoint: train.py writes a checkpoint every epoch and resumes from it; resuming does not change the selection rule.

addendum_2026_09_30c.when: 2026-09-30, after the second attempt was stopped at epoch 3 (k1) because the machine is CPU-starved at BelowNormal (about 2 ms per position forward, single thread), and BEFORE any stage-B model existed.
addendum_2026_09_30c.validation_rows: Selection reads the selection format (A: bo1, B: bo3) on EVERY position of its val games, as before; the other format is scored on one FIXED position per val game and is reported only. The rows are fixed for the run.
addendum_2026_09_30c.early_stop: Every arm stops after 6 epochs without a validation improvement (the text above says "at most 30 epochs"); the selected epoch is still the one with the lowest validation log-loss.
addendum_2026_09_30c.threads: One torch thread per process (measured faster than 2, 4 or 8 on this loaded machine).
